mechanism: Asynchronous RL training framework and tool-enhanced recipe for multi-turn SWE agents
evidence_scope: Using SKYRL-AGENT, we train SA-SWE-32B, a SWE agent trained from Qwen3-32B (24.4% Pass@1) purely with RL.
evidence_role: We introduce SKYRL-AGENT, a framework for efficient, multi-turn, long-horizon agent training and evaluation.
